show.description: After a masked one-night encounter with India’s hottest cricket star, struggling physiotherapy student Shanaaya disappears, unknowingly leaving behind the ring her mother gave her. Humiliated and determined to find the mysterious girl who “priced” him, star cricketer Vicky Khurana launches a public hunt. When fate makes Shanaaya his personal physio, a dangerous game of secrets, class conflict, and rising attraction begins.
